prerequisites: Good programming skills in at least one of the programming languages Java, C#

learning_outcomes.text: The graduate has the ability to develop, design and create new applications, systems or products using best practices of the field.

The graduate has the ability to evaluate different architectures and possible solutions to a problem and choose the right one for the specific requirements and constraints of the application to be developed.
The graduate has the ability to choose and use existing modules and environments for application development.

assessment_methods.method: Laboratory Activity (average of three out of six graded lab activities)
Project - Design and develop a solution for business process automation in Uifath Studio

assessment_rules: The final grade (M) is computed as follows: M = 10%B + 30%L + 70%P, where B is the grade for bonus activity, L is the average grade for lab activities, and P is the project grade. A minimum final grade of M >= 5.00 is required to pass this course. Students will be able to design and develop an automation solution for a repetitive business process and use the components of the Uifath platform properly.
